title.source_quote: Outline of the Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of AI-related Technology
title.why: The register title is the Cabinet Office's provisional English title, quoted from the stored English overview. original_title matches official.html ('人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する法律（ＡＩ法）') exactly. The government's own English renderings vary: the guideline stored for JP-05 says 'Act on Promotion of Research & Development(R&D), and Utilization of Artiﬁcial Intelligence-Related Technology' and the second AI Basic Plan stored for JP-06 says '... and deployment of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology'.

summary_claims.claim: It creates the AI Strategic Headquarters, chaired by the Prime Minister.
summary_claims.original_quote: 本部長：内閣総理大臣 構成員：全ての国務大臣
summary_claims.literal_translation: Head of the Headquarters: the Prime Minister; members: all Ministers of State

summary_claims.claim: The government ... may give guidance and advice to businesses and make information public.
summary_claims.original_quote: 事業者等への指導・助言・情報提供
summary_claims.literal_translation: guidance, advice and provision of information to business operators, etc.

summary_claims.claim: Businesses have a duty to endeavour to cooperate; the Act contains no penalties.
summary_claims.original_quote: 事業者は国等の施策に協力しなければならない
summary_claims.literal_translation: Business operators must cooperate with the measures of the State, etc.

key_terms.note: As in the overview's title; the second AI Basic Plan's translation uses 'deployment' for the same word.

情報提供 means 'provision of information'. The Cabinet Office overview renders the line as 'Guidance, advice and announcement to business operators and citizens'; the register's 'make information public' goes a step further than either.

issues: Duty to cooperate: the stored Japanese overview says '事業者は国等の施策に協力しなければならない' ('must cooperate'), with no 努める ('endeavour'); the register follows the Cabinet Office's provisional English overview ('Business operators shall endeavor to cooperate'). The two official overviews differ and the Act's text is not stored; check the Article on business operators' responsibilities in the official text or the MoJ translation before relying on either wording.
'Make information public' renders 情報提供 ('provision of information'); the Japanese does not say the information is published.
'The Act contains no penalties' is not in any stored text (it may well be true, but no stored file supports it).
language field carries a remark; proposed 'Japanese'.
note: Also checked: '情報収集、権利利益を侵害する事案の分析・対策検討、調査' (information gathering; analysis and consideration of countermeasures for cases infringing rights and interests; investigation) supports the summary's 'collect information on and investigate cases where AI infringes rights or interests'; '適正性のための国際規範に即した指針の整備' supports 'government guidelines consistent with international norms'. Dates in notes (enacted 28 May 2025, promulgated and partly in force 4 Jun 2025, fully in force 1 Sept 2025) match official.html and both overviews.
